title: com.docker.sandbox/port@1
description: Config schema for one port need: an in-container port to publish. The host side of any binding is the host's answer, never part of the request. Instance-shaped, keyed by container port and transport. The @1 names the capability contract, including this config schema and observable behavior. RELEASES.md defines when versions move and the maintainer-approved draft-stage exception.

family.description: The address families the service answers on inside the container: one of them, or dual for both. Omitted is ipv4 once the set is composed; an omitted family yields to another Kit's stated one for the same port.
